# Experiment Index

<!-- Generated by tools/experiment-index.py from exp/catalog.json; edit exp/catalog.json rather than this file. -->

This directory contains the curated experimental benchmarks, declarative schema specifications, analysis scripts, and aggregated statistical summaries for *MAVRA: Sharing and Maintaining Executable Knowledge for Data Agents*.

Live benchmark runs write transient execution logs and generated artifacts under Git-ignored `results/` (including LaTeX macros in `results/gen/` and vector figures in `results/figures/`), while clean benchmark inputs and aggregated statistical summaries are versioned here. Machine-readable metadata is stored in [catalog.json](catalog.json).

## §2.1 Workload Characterization and Motivation

| Experiment | Paper Mapping & Scope |
| --- | --- |
| [workload-characterization](workload-characterization/README.md)<br>Workload Characterization vs. Production BI Queries | Paper §2.1, Table 1, and Figure 1: contrasts Amazon Redset production warehouse queries against 100 memoryless LLM data-agent sessions across 5 metrics on a 1M-row retail star schema (80.5% exploration/validation SQL). |

## §6.2 Q1: Multi-Agent Population Sharing and Multi-Schema Generality

| Experiment | Paper Mapping & Scope |
| --- | --- |
| [population-sharing](population-sharing/README.md)<br>Multi-Agent Population Sharing on TPC-DS SF1 | Paper §6.2 (Q1, Figure 6): 16 sequential data agents across 5 independent runs on TPC-DS SF1 plus append-only sales restatement, comparing `No memory`, `Single-agent memory`, `Example retrieval`, and `MAVRA`. |
| [multi-schema-generality](multi-schema-generality/README.md)<br>Multi-Schema Generality: TPC-H, SSB, and BIRD Financial | Paper §6.1 and §6.6 (Table 6): declarative schema manifests, verified metric libraries, SQL reference queries, and multi-schema sharing and maintenance summaries across TPC-H SF1, Star Schema Benchmark (SSB) SF1, and BIRD `financial`. |

## §6.3 Q2: Semantic Lookup Scaling and Selective Routing

| Experiment | Paper Mapping & Scope |
| --- | --- |
| [semantic-lookup](semantic-lookup/README.md)<br>Semantic Lookup Scaling (26 to 1,000 Definitions) and Selective Risk-Coverage | Paper §4.3 and §6.3 (Q2, Table 3, Figure 8): nested enterprise metric catalogs ($M \in \{26, 100, 500, 1000\}$) across 8 domains on 390 main requests + 204 held-out paraphrases, comparing `Name match`, `Embedding top-1`, `TeCoD`, `Single CE (no diff)`, `Top-8 + LLM`, `MAVRA (0-retrain)`, and `MAVRA (refreshed)`. |

## §6.4 Q3: Maintenance Under Database Evolution

| Experiment | Paper Mapping & Scope |
| --- | --- |
| [schema-evolution](schema-evolution/README.md)<br>End-to-End Maintenance Under 11 Database Updates | Paper §6.4 (Q3, Figure 7, Table 4): 11 database updates across Synthetic Retail (1M rows) and TPC-H SF1 over 3 runs comparing `MAVRA` against `ACE`, `AWM`, `G-Memory`, `TeCoD`, `Shared recheck`, `Template + schema check`, and `Template + write invalidate`. |
| [maintenance-guards](maintenance-guards/README.md)<br>Value Guards, Historical Repair Gate G9, Unseen Bindings, and Sustained Writes | Paper §4.1, §4.4, §6.3, §6.4, and §6.6 (Tables 3, 4, 6): `NotNull` and `MeasureScale` value conditions, `G9` untouched-bucket historical check on 12-change replay (`reclass`), serving-vs-withholding split, 39-period unseen-binding generalization, 26-definition lookup confirmation, and 64-session sustained concurrent writes. |

## §6.5 Q4: Cross-Cutoff Predictive Feature Reuse (RelBench)

| Experiment | Paper Mapping & Scope |
| --- | --- |
| [relbench-predictive](relbench-predictive/README.md)<br>Cross-Cutoff Predictive Feature Reuse on RelBench | Paper §6.5 (Q4, Table 5): entity-level feature engineering across 5 temporal cutoffs on `rel-stack` and `rel-trial` with fixed LightGBM 4.6.0 protocol and mandatory leakage audit against `No memory`, `Single-agent memory`, `Example retrieval`, `ACE`, `AWM`, `G-Memory`, `TeCoD`, and `FeatPilot*`. |
| [relbench-attribution](relbench-attribution/README.md)<br>Three-Run RelBench Evaluation and Cutoff-1 Refitting Attribution | Paper §6.5 (Q4, Table 5): three-run repeated evaluation of `MAVRA` and `No memory` on `rel-stack` and `rel-trial`, pure cutoff-1 frozen-SQL refitting control across cutoffs 2–5, and per-task temporal shift attribution. |

## §6.6 Q5: Mechanism Isolation, Policy Replay, and Warehouse Scaling

| Experiment | Paper Mapping & Scope |
| --- | --- |
| [cache-baseline-tpcds](cache-baseline-tpcds/README.md)<br>Condition Sharing, Snapshot Binding, and TPC-DS Replay | Paper §6.2 and §6.6 (Table 6): evaluates condition sharing vs. generic SQL-text check caching, `REPEATABLE READ` snapshot-bound validation (`0 / 11,297` vs. `261` TOCTOU anomalies), 16-shard `mavra_versions` trigger throughput, `repair_unique` ambiguity safety, and 4-policy TPC-DS replay. |
| [premise-optimization](premise-optimization/README.md)<br>Publication Gates, Equivalence Optimization, and Premise Rollback | Paper §4.2 and §6.6: evaluates publication admission gates `G1`–`G7`, equivalence-preserving revision optimization (`KeyRange` and `DateKeysContiguous`), and automatic rollback from `r1` to `r0` when out-of-order date keys invalidate optimization premises. |
| [policy-replay](policy-replay/README.md)<br>Paired Fixed-Catalog Maintenance Policy Replay | Paper §6.6 (Q5, Table 6): fixed-catalog paired replay across TPC-DS, TPC-H, SSB, and BIRD `financial` comparing `Write invalidate`, `Schema check only`, `Table-level data tests`, and `MAVRA` (`condition`) with exact-duplicate and date-key local repairs. |
| [shared-validation](shared-validation/README.md)<br>Shared Validation Scaling Across 1 to 32 Concurrent Agents | Paper §6.6 (Q5, Figure 9): post-update validation query counts and database time across 16 shared definitions and 1–32 staggered or simultaneous agents (3 randomized blocks = 108 cells), comparing `per-agent`, `full-recheck`, and `mavra`. |
| [mechanism-studies](mechanism-studies/README.md)<br>Controlled Mechanism Studies: Representation, Overlap, and TOCTOU Barrier | Paper §6.6 (Q5): Part A $2 \times 2$ feature-definition vs. full-program reuse on `rel-stack`; Part B 72-cell fixed-catalog condition-overlap sweep ($k=1..8$) vs. SQL-text check cache; Part C 30-trial controlled-barrier TOCTOU snapshot isolation. |
| [tpcds-scaling](tpcds-scaling/README.md)<br>Warehouse Scale-Up (TPC-DS SF1/SF3/SF10) and Core Coverage | Paper §6.5 and §6.6 (Q5): TPC-DS SF1/SF3/SF10 validation and repair scalability from 2.88M to 28.80M `store_sales` rows, 4-call budget-matched RelBench `No memory` truncation control, and static single-fact $N{:}1$ `G3` template coverage across four schemas. |

## Benchmark Artifacts and CLI Entrypoints

| Experiment | Curated Data & Inputs | Benchmark CLI & Configuration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| workload-characterization | Aggregated SQL AST fingerprint statistics (`workload-stats.json`, `workload-stats.md`) and Amazon Redset warehouse statistics (`redset/redset_stats.json`). | `./target/release/mavra workload-bench --rows 1000000 --agent openai`; SQL AST fingerprinting via `pglast`. |
| population-sharing | Per-step cumulative token, SQL-call, database-time, and accuracy trajectories in `population-stats.json` and metric definitions in `tpcds-defs.json`. | `./target/release/mavra metric-bench --population --defs exp/population-sharing/tpcds-defs.json --modes direct,metric-private,metric-global-exref,metric-global-full --repeats 5`. |
| multi-schema-generality | Declarative schema manifests in `schemas/`, verified definition libraries in `libs/`, reference SQL in `queries/`, and aggregated summaries (`generality-stats.json`, `replay-safety-summary.json`, `e2e/scen-stats.json`). | `cargo test --release --locked specchange` and `./target/release/mavra replay-bench --spec exp/multi-schema-generality/schemas/<schema>.json --libs exp/multi-schema-generality/libs/<schema>.json`. |
| semantic-lookup | Nested catalogs (`catalog_26..1000.json`), request sets (`requests_*.json`), example pools (`pool_*.json`), disjoint synthetic training phrasings (`train_*.jsonl`), and aggregated scaling/risk-coverage summaries (`scale-summary.json`, `risk-coverage.json`). | `catalog_1000_sha256=f85bc3e9bc1da3c8c1e31593d6adc94c667bf5aa2ad15df3267adfffb5cd0ec2`; `BAAI/bge-m3` + 3-seed `BAAI/bge-reranker-base` (`XLM-RoBERTa`) in BF16 (`run_gpu.sh`, `analyse.py`). |
| schema-evolution | Frozen question banks (`bank-synthetic.json`, `bank-tpch.json`) and aggregated per-cell, per-group, and per-change outcomes (`study-stats.json`). | `python3 exp/schema-evolution/run-study.py` and `python3 exp/schema-evolution/analyse.py --tex results/gen/change-study.tex`. |
| maintenance-guards | 12-change guard replay outcomes (`replay-guards.json`), unseen-binding report (`binding-report.json`), serving split (`served-split.json`), lookup confirmation summaries (`lookup-confirm/`, `lookup-glm/`, `lookup-tecod/`), and sustained-write summary (`sustained/summary.json`). | `./target/release/mavra binding-bench --defs exp/population-sharing/tpcds-defs.json` and `cargo test --release --locked q5_bench_tests::postgres_sustained_writes -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1`. |
| relbench-predictive | Aggregated per-session validation/test scores, token/runtime breakdowns (`paper-sessions.json`), and cold-start vs. reuse work breakdown (`reuse-work-data.json`). | `python3 tools/relbench/prepare.py` and `python3 tools/relbench/harness.py --arm mavra-retry`; LightGBM 4.6.0 and row-level temporal audit. |
| relbench-attribution | Per-run audit summaries (`gate-r1.json`..`gate-r3.json`), frozen cutoff-1 refit evaluations (`frozen-rel-stack.json`, `frozen-rel-trial.json`, `frozen-summary.json`), and task-shift attribution (`shift-attribution.json`). | `python3 tools/relbench/paper-stats.py --out results/gen` and `python3 tools/relbench/frozen-summary.py`. |
| cache-baseline-tpcds | Aggregated statistics for 1M/4M condition-sharing sweeps, snapshot-binding isolation, 16-shard trigger throughput, ambiguity safety, and TPC-DS replay (`*-stats.json`). | `cargo test --release --locked q5_bench_tests:: -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1` and `./target/release/mavra replay-bench --libs exp/population-sharing/tpcds-defs.json --schema tpcds`. |
| premise-optimization | Premise-invalidation rollback report (`premise-report.json`) and revision-optimization speedup summary (`opt-stats.md`). | `./target/release/mavra metric-bench --rows 500000 --modes metric-global-full --changes append,latekey --trace`. |
| policy-replay | Aggregated four-schema policy-replay contingency tables and per-change breakdowns (`replay-policies.json`). | `./target/release/mavra replay-bench --libs exp/multi-schema-generality/libs/<schema>.json --policies condition --oracles snapshot` and `python3 exp/policy-replay/analyse.py --tex results/gen/replay-policies.tex`. |
| shared-validation | Aggregated 108-cell validation query count and database runtime distributions across 1–32 agents (`stats.json`). | `cargo test --release --locked q5_bench_tests::postgres_shared_validation_scaling -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1` and `python3 exp/shared-validation/analyse.py --tex results/gen/shared-validation.tex`. |
| mechanism-studies | Frozen source feature input (`source-input.json`), 8-cell factorial representation summary (`representation-summary.json`), and 72-cell overlap + 30-trial barrier summary (`system-summary.json`). | `python3 -m unittest discover -s exp/mechanism-studies` and `python3 exp/mechanism-studies/run_systems.py`. |
| tpcds-scaling | Aggregated SF1/SF3/SF10 validation/repair timings and row counts (`scaling-summary.json`), 4-call RelBench truncation summary (`relbench-4call-truncation.json`), and `G3` coverage summary (`g3-coverage.json`). | `./target/release/mavra --pool 16 replay-bench --libs exp/population-sharing/tpcds-defs.json --schema tpcds --tpcds-db tpcds_sf10 --policies revoke,schema,tabletest,condition --oracles snapshot`. |

## Index Validation

After editing `exp/catalog.json`, regenerate this index from the repository root with `python3 tools/experiment-index.py`. Pass `--check` in CI to verify directory coverage, file references, and index synchronization without running benchmarks.
